title: Who records the decisions during each stand-up
detail: No decision was recorded at the 13:00 stand-up on 2 November. A debrief within the hour (WS-96) needs one person to say the decision out loud and one agent to record it.
recommend: team-collaboration@web-summit.angelo drafts it; the chair confirms in one line
options: team-collaboration@web-summit.angelo drafts it from the chair's words and the chair confirms
